description: This file defines API route handlers related to product management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting products, and managing product images. The routes utilize database functions and storage handlers, serving as the main API interface for product operations.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify the API is running.

methods.name: List[Product] list_products( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Optional search string to match product names (case-insensitive)"), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Lists products with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: Product get_product( product_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the product"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: Product update_product( product_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the product"), payload: ProductUpdate = None, )
methods.description: Updates an existing product by its ID.

methods.name: delete_product( product_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the product"), )
methods.description: Deletes a product and its associated image if present.

methods.name: Product upload_image( product_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the product"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Image file (jpeg/png, max 5MB)"), )
methods.description: Uploads or replaces a product image.

methods.name: Product delete_image( product_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the product"), )
methods.description: Deletes the image associated with a product.
